newsitem.title: FRANCE: INSEE details contributions to French GDP.
newsitem.headline: INSEE details contributions to French GDP.

text.p: National statistics institute INSEE gave the following details on fourth quarter and full-year gross domestic product data. It said earlier GDP rose 0.2 percent in the fourth quarter and 1.3 percent over the full year.
Fell 0.5 percent in fourth quarter, contribution to GDP minus 0.3 percentage points.
Rose average annual 2.3 percent in full-year 1996 and contributed 1.4 percentage points to full-year growth.
Rose 0.2 percent in fourth quarter. INSEE said contribution to GDP very mildly positive although put at zero due to rounding.
Fell average annual 0.6 percent in full-year 1996, giving a negative contribution to full-year growth of 0.1 percentage points.
Contribution to fourth quarter growth 0.4 percentage points. Contribution to full-year 1996 growth minus 0.6 point.
INSEE said net contribution of trade to GDP, put at zero, was very slightly negative in the fourth quarter.
The contribution to full-year growth was 0.4 percentage points.
INSEE said the effect of the number of working days was slightly negative in the fourth quarter, although by less than a quarter of a percentage point.
Manufacturing output fell 0.5 percent in the fourth quarter after rising 1.3 percent in the third quarter.
The fourth-quarter fall in manufacturing output included the following:
- transport equipment (-2.9 percent after 1.9 percent in third quarter)
- industrial capital goods (0.9 percent after 0.4 percent)
